items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I hired this, I just, I just boy, Wendell, he played two nights

ctx.x: With Paul Walburn. Yeah, I remember now.

Yeah, I worked, at seven weeks in this place. Until I took sick. I took sick, well, I had to quit playing. I suffered with my stomach, and I had to quit. And I had to quit the job. Willie came back the same week, I, well, I would have been sick, because I wished for him to come back. When he came back, he didn't care to wait, he only waited a week, I told him I couldn't do it. And that's where, I hired this, I just, I just boy, Wendell, he played two nights, because I told him, I said, I couldn't, my stomach was…
